Name: GlassHammer Hope To Rise
Author: T5GlassHammer
Description:
[size=6]﻿﻿Hope To Rise
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/tgOsmSV.png[/img]
[size=5]Summary[/size]

[size=3]Hope to Rise is a mod where the player wakes up to find that the two children in Stardew Valley are in a deep coma-like sleep. Out of his depth and feeling worried, Dr. Harvey asks the player for some assistance in waking the children. The player soon discovers that while the kids appear dead to the world, their consciousness has been transported into another realm ruled by the Lord of Dreams. Although the children are trapped in this mysterious world, the player has discovered a way to safely travel between the two worlds. The player must find a way to wake the kids before their dreams turn into a never-ending nightmare.[/size]

[size=5]Features[/size]

[size=4]The Dream World[/size]
[size=3]A new world the player can travel to, only when they go to sleep while holding a special item. It consists of 4 explorable areas and a hidden location that's unlocked towards the end of the quest line. There's a shop in the 2nd area where the player can buy custom items only in the Dream World.[/size][size=4]
[/size]
[size=4]The Boss Fight[/size]
[size=3]The questline concludes with a boss fight with a unique enemy. The Boss comes equipped with different attack patterns that the player can respond to with the help of the custom items purchased in the Dream World.
[list]
[*]Custom Tiles: Slow the player down upon contact, but can be disabled by using a watering can
[*]The Boss: Can only take damage from the Sword purchased in the Dream World
[/list][/size]
[size=5]Tips and Notes
[/size]This mod requires that you interact with existing NPCs and assumes you are acquainted with them. It's HIGHLY recommended that you play through 
Stardew Valley enough to be introduced to combat and all the NPCs before activating this mod.
[list]
[*]To activate the quest, you need to have unlocked the Community Center so you can enter the Wizard's Tower freely and have a friendship level of at least 2 with the Wizard.
[*]While you're in the Dream World, time does not stop. You should still take care of your crops and be mindful of any festivals
[*]While playing, you will not be allowed to interact with Vincent and Jas in Stardew Valley until the quest is complete
[/list]
[size=5]Installation Guide
[/size]This mod is 1.6 compatible 

[size=4]Additional Mods[/size]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]HxW Tilesheets and HxW Fairy Garden Furniture
[*]Mail Frame Work
[*]Smapi 
[/list][size=4]Downloading[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Download from here and unzip the file[/size]
[*][size=2]Place all the folders inside your mods folder[/size]
